english.note: This is the all-purpose choice for an odd or strange thing or idea.
Use this colloquial noun phrase for an odd or unusual object that attracts interest in everyday contexts.

examples.english: I really can't figure out this oddity.
examples.traditional: 呢件古怪嘢我真係估佢唔到。
